summary: Frontend-only verification (mobile 390x844, admin@mikilab.de PRO) of the two new additions: (1) 'Diagnosi Recenti' list in Photo Diagnosis (render, thumb, expand markdown, accordion, delete + persistence, both entry paths Home card and Lab tool) and (2) expanded Momy Lab onboarding tour (10 slides incl. 'Tutti i miei strumenti', base-filter slide and updated commands slide, scrollable body, done/close/replay). BOTH FEATURES PASS. No functional defects found. Only note: the admin account had 1 (not 2) saved diagnosis at start and its thumbnail rendered broken; I re-seeded 3 valid test diagnoses via /api/diagnosi/save and everything rendered correctly.

issues: The floating 'Radio' and 'Parla' FABs sit on top of the last item of the Diagnosi Recenti list (delete/chevron buttons of the last row are partially covered). Clicks still succeeded (no overlay interception) but consider extra bottom padding below the list.

action_items: Optional: increase bottom padding of PhotoDiagnosi (pb-4 -> pb-24) so the Radio/Parla FABs do not overlap the last 'Diagnosi Recenti' row on mobile.

Verify the thumb stored by the pre-existing (curl-seeded) diagnosis: it was NOT a valid data URL and rendered as a broken (naturalWidth=0). Real app flow (makeThumb) produces a valid data:image/jpeg URL and renders fine, so this is only a seeding artefact — but consider guarding the with onError fallback to the Camera icon.
critical_code_review_comments: PhotoDiagnosi.deleteRecent() removes the item from state optimistically and swallows any DELETE error (empty catch) — a failed delete silently reappears only after reload. Consider re-loading/reverting on failure.
loadRecent() swallows errors silently; no loading/error state for the Diagnosi Recenti list (guideline: every API call should have loading/success/error states).
has no onError handler; a corrupt/invalid thumb shows a broken-image icon instead of the existing Camera fallback.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/seed_diagnosi.py (new seed helper, no app code changed)
seed_data_creation: Created 3 diagnoses for admin@mikilab.de via POST /api/diagnosi/save (modes difetti, impasto, macchine; results prefixed TEST_; two with a valid 60x60 JPEG thumb, one with thumb=null to test the Camera fallback). One was deleted during the delete test; 2 TEST_ items remain intentionally so the next agent/main agent can see the list. Script: /app/backend/tests/seed_diagnosi.py
context_for_next_testing_agent: DIAGNOSI RECENTI verified in detail: GET /api/diagnosi/recent loads on mount; list shown under [data-testid=diagnosi-recenti] with heading 'Diagnosi Recenti' + hint 'Rivedi causa e soluzione senza rifare la foto.'; ordering is newest-first (macchine, impasto, difetti); thumbs render (naturalWidth=60) and the thumb-less item shows the Camera icon fallback; [data-testid=diagnosi-open-<id>] expands and ReactMarkdown renders headings/bullets (h2=2, li=2) and collapses on second click; only ONE item stays open at a time (accordion behaviour confirmed); [data-testid=diagnosi-delete-<id>] removes the row immediately and the deletion PERSISTS after reload (3 -> 2). Both entry paths show the list: Home [data-testid=home-diagnosi-card] and Lab (nav-tab-maestro -> close lab-onboarding -> maestro-step-5 -> maestro-tool-diagnosi). No real AI analysis was triggered. LAB TOUR verified: auto-opens when localStorage 'mikilab_lab_tour_done' is absent; exactly 10 slides / 10 dots: 1 Ciao sono Michele, 2 Passo 1 Hardware, 3 Passo 2 Ricette & Forno, 4 'Trova le ricette per Base', 5 Passo 3 Logistica, 6 Passo 4 Pianificazione, 7 Passo 5 Operativita, 8 Passo 6 Chiusura, 9 'Tutti i miei strumenti' (570 chars, lists all lab tools, body scrollable max-h-[40vh] 341/338), 10 'E i miei comandi' (mentions Diagnosi Foto AND 'Diagnosi Recenti'). lab-onboarding-done closes and sets flag=1; [data-testid=mohammed-replay-tour] re-opens it; lab-onboarding-close (X) closes it. No console errors other than the expected pre-login 401 from /api/auth/me.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no defects. The initially reported '2 saved diagnoses' was actually 1 in the DB (GET /api/diagnosi/recent returned a single doc), and its thumb was not a valid data URL so the rendered broken; re-seeded valid data confirmed correct rendering.
